description: Portable route-context base for the sanitized private distribution. Put machine-specific routes in ~/.ai/route-context.local.json.

route.name: Project-layer plan and draft document placement
notes: Resolve the project-control directory from an explicit project route or index.md; never infer it from a similarly named checkout.
This route resolves placement only and does not authorize creating or editing a file.

route.name: Loopback integration verification
notes: Inspect whether the command binds a local port before choosing a sandbox escalation.
Keep approval scoped to the project runner or exact operation.

route.name: Gradle wrapper local cache write
notes: When ~/.gradle is outside the writable sandbox, request a narrow ./gradlew escalation instead of changing GRADLE_USER_HOME by default.

route.name: MCP registration and mount diagnosis
notes: Distinguish not configured, configured but not registered, registered but not mounted, and mounted but unauthenticated or unreachable.
The current task tool inventory does not prove installation state.
